title: Basel SMA Operational-Risk Capital Calculator
description: Computes Business Indicator, BIC, Internal Loss Multiplier, and Operational Risk Capital per BIS OPE25 (Basel Standardised Measurement Approach), with a jurisdiction toggle for the EU CRR3 / UK PRA national-discretion ILM=1 fix. Client-side. Zero PII.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction toggle affecting the ILM national-discretion fix

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_basel_sma_operational_risk_capital
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes Basel Standardised Measurement Approach operational risk capital: Business Indicator (BI = ILDC+SC+FC per OPE25.5), Business Indicator Component via the marginal 12/15/18% bucket table (OPE25.7), Loss Component (15x average annual losses over 10 years, OPE25.8), Internal Loss Multiplier (ILM = ln(e-1+(LC/BIC)^0.8), OPE25.8), Operational Risk Capital (ORC=BICxILM) and RWA (12.5xORC), with a jurisdiction toggle for the EU/UK national-discretion ILM=1 fix (OPE25.11). Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/636-basel-sma-oprisk-calculator.html for interactive use.
